text:
priya: Cutting candidate from branch `release/3.4.2` -> sha `abc1234`. Target promo window today 18:00 UTC. Requesting pin + signoffs.

deploy-bot: build queued for sha abc1234. artifact: `inference-service:3.4.2-rc1`. est build 3m.

nate: canary plan suggestion: start 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%. 5m checks, 15m for larger steps. prefer KV warm before lift.

kim: +1. Will run KV prefill and small-batch warmup. Also flagging cpu-side autoscaler thresholds.

darren: FYI we saw a perf bump on staging with seq_len=4k last week. For prod canary we should set `batch.max=8` and use conservative quant profile.

jessie: release notes draft: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/3.4.2-rc1 (contains model tweaks + runtime mem safety fix). No DB migrations.

priya: Proposed promo steps: 1) cut candidate 2) deploy canary 2% + smoke 3) if OK, 10% after 10m 4) 25% after 25m 5) 100% at ~45m. Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% OR p99 latency +25% OR eval regression.

oncall-sheriff: I'll be watching dashboards and error budgets. Will call rollback on SLO breach.

kim: prefill started: ```./tools/prefill_kv.sh --model gptx --keys 200k --target=canary``` kicked off.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: route=canary, weight=2%, deploy_id=dep-3310011223-01.

nate: quick smoke: `/health` on canary nodes => all green. Tail logs: ```kubectl logs -l app=inference -f --since=2m | grep ERROR``` => no errors.

jessie: Ran eval suite (12 tests): 12/12 pass, minor tokenization diff in test-07 (non-blocking).

priya: request explicit signoff from eng leads before moving to 10%: @nate @kim @darren
nate: signoff
kim: signoff
darren: signoff, keep watch on batch_size and cache_hit_rate.

deploy-bot: traffic update: canary -> 10% (dep-3310011223-02).

priya: moving to 25% in 15m if metrics stable. After 25% I'll run the promote command to pin: `redwoodctl promote --pin=abc1234 --env=prod`
darren: add rollback CLI snippet to the runbook: `redwoodctl rollback --to=previous --env=prod`. Keep playbook open.
oncall-sheriff: confirmed. Pager escalation path ready.

priya: note: if a hotfix is required we'll pause and originate hotfix branch; triage call will be started. Otherwise schedule promotion to 100% at +45m.

deploy-bot: promotion to 100% scheduled at +45m (dep-3310011223-03).

jessie: I'll update the public-facing release notes and changelog once 100% completes.

priya: Thanks team :thumbsup: — proceeding unless any last-minute blockers.
